Backup & restore

Your register, signature, stamp and settings are stored inside this phone's browser. If browser data is cleared or the phone changes, it is lost — so keep a backup file safely (e.g. on Google Drive or WhatsApp to yourself).

A backup file contains: saved letters register, signature & stamp images, signatory names and current draft.

Send on WhatsApp

Each resident gets the letter text personalised with their name and flat. Tap Send one by one — WhatsApp opens with the message ready; you just press send.
